records.title: Meyer Yulewitz
records.summary: Meyer Yulewitz was named alongside Meir Schreibman as a leader of the Non-Aligned Workers’ Party list in the Sokółka Jewish community elections. He spoke with Schreibman at a campaign meeting in the old synagogue.
